new_constructors.meaning: An alternative whose two source actions retain their respective triggers and branch-scoped exception contexts; the outer trigger is only the union of the branch activation events and does not create a cross-product between actions and triggers.
new_constructors.name: conditional_action_alternative_v4

new_constructors.meaning: The separately bounded exception contexts of two conditionally alternative disposal branches, retained with their exact connecting clause without asserting complete absence of other exceptions.
new_constructors.name: joint_branch_exception_scope_v4

value.rationale: 当前残差分为三类：e82b 的员工披露许可和“不得向任何人披露”条款未被现有窄词形覆盖；6fce 已取得动作与留存原子，但 Free composition 没有把它们组成保留动作—触发对应关系的可执行规范；8fb 只规定应请求返还，不能为匹配 nda-16 而虚构终止触发。更新因此仅增强普通 Free composition：从明确条款生成员工许可及有界第三方禁止，将留存原子组成规范，并用带分支触发和分支例外的条件式替代关系组合异步返还/销毁动作。未知触发继续不输出规范，完整缺失也不从词法失败推断。
